Measuring each strategy in turn. The base budget is about 8 seconds, but readings that will not settle grow the scene and get measured again, so an unsteady device can take a couple of minutes. The screen is kept on for the duration; please leave the device idle.
Each function was measured separately and sorted fastest first (×1.00 is fastest within that function). Adopting enables an independent order for each function below; the global order is unchanged.

The default order reflects what is usually fastest, not what is fastest on this device. A benchmark measures each function here and sorts it accordingly.
